# InControl Desktop

> Ollama chat for Windows. On this PC by default. A rented GPU only after you connect one.

## Overview

InControl is an Ollama chat app for Windows. Chat stays on this PC until a rented GPU is connected. A rental sends the prompts you submit to Ollama on that machine. The banner names that machine. There is no llama.cpp backend.

RunPod lookup reads `RUNPOD_API_KEY` from the environment. The key is not stored, and the lookup does not send the chat.

Version 0.3.0 is the source tree. There is no MSIX. The repository is https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/incontrol.

## Quick Start

```
# Prerequisites: Ollama on this PC
ollama pull llama3.2
ollama serve

# From source. See docs/INSTALLATION.md.
git clone https://github.com/mcp-tool-shop-org/incontrol.git
cd incontrol
dotnet restore
dotnet build
dotnet run --project src/InControl.App
```

`dotnet build` compiles the app assembly. Windows App SDK packaging can fail when the Appx MSBuild task is missing. That failure is the missing MSIX step. The app project still builds its DLL. There is no signed package to install.

## NuGet Packages

- `InControl.Core` — Domain models, conversation types, shared abstractions
- `InControl.Inference` — LLM backend abstraction with streaming chat and model management (includes Ollama implementation)

## API Entry Points

```csharp
// Streaming chat via InControl.Inference
var client = inferenceClientFactory.Create("ollama");
await foreach (var token in client.StreamChatAsync(messages))
{
    Console.Write(token);
}
```

## Architecture

```
InControl.App (WinUI 3)       → UI layer
InControl.ViewModels           → Presentation (MVVM, CommunityToolkit.Mvvm)
InControl.Services             → Business logic
InControl.Inference            → Ollama
InControl.Core                 → Shared types
```

## Constraints

- Windows only (WinUI 3 / Windows App SDK 1.6)
- Requires .NET 9.0
- GPU: minimum RTX 3060 (8GB), recommended RTX 4080/5080 (16GB)
- Build from source with `dotnet build`. See `docs/INSTALLATION.md`. Version 0.3.0 is the source tree. There is no MSIX.
- App project must target x64; class libraries use AnyCPU

## Data Storage

Chat stays on this PC until a rented GPU is connected. A rental sends the prompts you submit to Ollama on that machine.

- Sessions: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\InControl\sessions\`
- Logs: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\InControl\logs\`
- Cache: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\InControl\cache\`
- Exports: `%USERPROFILE%\Documents\InControl\exports\`
